notes.title: Regular Update #1
notes.content: [p][b]\[New Content][/b][/p][list][*][p]All heroes now have starting skills.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Modifications][/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted all heroes' skill sets to enhance class diversity.[/p][/*][*][p]Glacial effect reworked.[/p][p]Glacial 1: Beast HP +25% → More special beasts spawn[/p][p]Glacial 2: Light the campfire cost +5 → Beast HP +30%[/p][/*][/list][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various issues that caused the game to stuck.[/p][/*][/list]
